user.title: Connect OpenAlarm
user.description: Create an API key in the OpenAlarm console under API Keys, then paste it here. The key decides which alarms and panic buttons Home Assistant can reach.

data_description.base_url: Leave this alone unless you were told otherwise.

location.title: Choose a location
location.description: This key can reach more than one location. Each one is set up separately.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect OpenAlarm
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {location} no longer works. It may have been deleted or disabled. Paste a replacement that can still reach this location.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach OpenAlarm. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: OpenAlarm rejected that key. Check it was copied whole, and that it is still enabled in the console.
error.no_locations: That key cannot reach any alarms or panic buttons. Check its scope in the console.
error.wrong_location: That key cannot reach this location. Use one scoped to it, or add the other location separately.

abort.already_configured: This location is already set up.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arms an alarm. Leave the mode empty to arm without one.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The mode to arm in, such as away or night. Custom modes work too.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Triggers an alarm, which starts its escalation policy.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The mode to trigger in. Leave empty to use the alarm's current one.

panic_clear.name: Clear panic
panic_clear.description: Clears a panic button's open incident.
